prompt: Number of active customers last month
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.business_id) AS active_customers_last_month
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer AS c
WHERE c.is_active = TRUE
  AND c.effective_from_date <= (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date - 1)
  AND (c.effective_to_date IS NULL OR c.effective_to_date > (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date - 1));

prompt: Clients in default at end of August 2026
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.business_id AS client_id, c.display_name AS client_name
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.business_date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
WHERE f.default_flag = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_day.calendar_date)
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS snapshot_fact
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS snapshot_day ON snapshot_day.date_key = snapshot_fact.business_date_key
    WHERE snapshot_day.calendar_year_number = 2026
      AND snapshot_day.month_number = 8
  )
ORDER BY client_name, client_id;

prompt: Show total actual loan repayments by customer for January 2026
sql:
SELECT
    f.customer_key,
    SUM(f.actual_payment_amount) AS total_actual_repayments
FROM
    bank_dwh.fact_loan_repayment f
JOIN
    bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE
    d.calendar_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND d.calendar_date <= DATE '2026-01-31'
GROUP BY
    f.customer_key
ORDER BY
    total_actual_repayments DESC;

prompt: Count card authorizations by merchant in August 2026
sql:
SELECT
    m.display_name AS merchant_name,
    COUNT(*) AS authorization_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization fca
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON fca.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_merchant m
  ON fca.merchant_key = m.merchant_key
WHERE dd.calendar_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'
  AND dd.calendar_date <= DATE '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY m.display_name
ORDER BY authorization_count DESC;

prompt: Show total closing deposit balance by branch on August 31, 2026
sql:
SELECT
    b.display_name AS branch_name,
    SUM(f.closing_balance_amount) AS total_closing_balance
FROM
    bank_dwh.fact_deposit_balance_daily f
JOIN
    bank_dwh.dim_branch b
    ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN
    bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE
    d.calendar_date = DATE '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY
    b.display_name
ORDER BY
    total_closing_balance DESC;

SELECT alert_severity_code,
       COUNT(*) AS fraud_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_fraud_alert
GROUP BY alert_severity_code
ORDER BY fraud_alert_count DESC;

prompt: Using fact_credit_risk_exposure_daily, show average probability_of_default_rate by branch on August 31, 2026
sql:
SELECT
    b.display_name AS branch_name,
    AVG(f.probability_of_default_rate) AS avg_pdr
FROM bank_dwh.fact_credit_risk_exposure_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
    ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY b.display_name
ORDER BY b.display_name;

prompt: Using fact_payment_transaction, show total amount by currency using currency_key and dim_currency.currency_code
sql:
SELECT
    d.currency_code,
    SUM(f.original_amount) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_payment_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency d
    ON f.currency_key = d.currency_key
GROUP BY d.currency_code
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

prompt: Using fact_account_balance_daily, show daily total closing_balance_amount by currency from August 1 through 7, 2026
sql:
SELECT
    d.calendar_date,
    c.currency_code,
    SUM(f.closing_balance_amount) AS total_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_balance_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c
    ON f.currency_key = c.currency_key
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-07'
GROUP BY d.calendar_date, c.currency_code
ORDER BY d.calendar_date, c.currency_code;

SELECT investigation_status_code,
       COUNT(*) AS alert_count
  FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert
 GROUP BY investigation_status_code
 ORDER BY alert_count DESC;
